changes: Added import fallback for direct script execution via python -u.
Enforced low-RAM runtime defaults in active path: batch=4, workers=0, pin_memory=false, grad_accum_steps=2.
Raised training RAM gate threshold from 75% to 77% for future process starts.
Added timeout-aware RAM/download gating to avoid indefinite stalls.
Added OOM-safe step handling and gradient accumulation.
Added persistent per-epoch progress JSONL logging for restart-safe monitoring.
Explicit checkpoint loading with weights_only=false for compatibility.
Added singleton training lock to prevent future concurrent train.py launches writing the same checkpoints/logs.
Added warm-start fallback: if attempt-mismatch checkpoint exists, reuse model weights instead of cold start.
Expanded auto-retry policy to increase epochs/patience and adapt LR/label smoothing when targets are missed.
Added RAM/CPU/VRAM-aware decisions and runtime control flags.
Aligned low-memory dataloader worker strategy to zero workers in current constrained mode.
Removed high-noise mappings: elastane_spandex, polyolefin, ramie, hemp.
Further reduced noisy fabric aliases by dropping lace->Cotton and plush->Suede mappings while keeping all classes above minimum image threshold.

open_risks_and_blockers: Current best validation quality is still far from required done criteria.
Worst-class recall remains low (about 0.3167 in latest saved stream, still below 0.40 target).
System RAM frequently exceeds configured threshold and can still slow epoch transitions.
Concurrent train.py processes are actively racing on shared checkpoint/log files; singleton lock is in code for future launches only.

if_process_alive: Do not kill the current active training PID.
if_process_stops: Continue attempts until all done criteria are met.
